items.stem: A company reports a healthy profit yet cannot pay its suppliers this month. What distinction explains this?

options.text: Profit is an accounting result; cash is the money actually available
options.rationale: Correct: a profitable business can still run short of cash due to timing.

options.text: Profit and cash are always identical
options.rationale: They differ because of timing, credit and non-cash items.

options.text: Profit means suppliers are automatically paid
options.rationale: Payment depends on available cash, not reported profit.

options.text: Cash is irrelevant if profit is positive
options.rationale: Cash flow determines whether obligations can be met.

items.explanation: Correct: a profitable business can still run short of cash due to timing.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which statements about the functions of a business are correct? (Select TWO)

options.text: Marketing, operations, finance and people must work together
options.rationale: Correct: the functions form an interconnected system.

options.text: A single customer order can touch several functions
options.rationale: Correct: an order flows across sales, operations and finance.

options.text: Each function should work in complete isolation
options.rationale: Silos cause breakdowns in serving the customer.

options.text: Finance is the only function that matters
options.rationale: All functions contribute to value creation.

items.explanation: Correct: the functions form an interconnected system.

items.stem: A new owner says 'my target customer is everyone.' Why is this weak?

options.text: Trying to serve everyone usually means serving no one well
options.rationale: Correct: a defined target lets the business tailor and differentiate its offer.

options.text: It is the ideal marketing strategy

options.rationale: Markets contain distinct segments with different needs.

options.text: Positioning is unnecessary for small businesses
options.rationale: Even small businesses benefit from a clear target.

items.explanation: Correct: a defined target lets the business tailor and differentiate its offer.
